callouts.id: n个连续的阶乘之积有多少个因子#1
callouts.title: 问题1
callouts.body: 函数$d(n)$表示整数$n$的因子的个数，定义$$D(n):=d(1!\cdot 2!\cdots n!)$$求极限$$\lim_{n\to \infty}D(n)^{1/n}$$

classification_result.id: n个连续的阶乘之积有多少个因子#1

if_problem.statement_en: Let $d(n)$ denote the number of positive divisors of the integer $n$, and define $$D(n):=d(1!\cdot 2!\cdots n!).$$ Find the limit $$\lim_{n\to \infty}D(n)^{1/n}.$$
prerequisites: factorization of factorials via prime valuations

callouts.id: n个连续的阶乘之积有多少个因子#2
callouts.title: 初步想法
callouts.body: 数论函数$d(x)$是具有不完全积性的函数，即如果有两个互素的整数$(m,n)=1$，那么$d(mn)=d(m)d(n)$。那么既然我们需要分析的大数有很明显的乘法结构，我们可以分析一下其素因分解，从而简化$d$这个函数的表达，方便做进一步的渐近分析。

classification_result.id: n个连续的阶乘之积有多少个因子#2

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Reduce divisor-function asymptotics via prime factorization
if_strategy_template.summary_en: Use the multiplicative structure of the divisor function by first decomposing the target integer into its prime-power factorization. This converts the divisor-counting problem into estimating exponents of primes and then performing asymptotic analysis on the resulting expression.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when a large integer has a clear multiplicative structure, especially products such as factorials or related arithmetic constructions, and one needs asymptotics for the divisor function or similar arithmetic functions.

callouts.id: n个连续的阶乘之积有多少个因子#4
callouts.title: 素数定理,Poussin&Hadamard 1896
callouts.body: $\pi(x)$为素数计数函数，此函数定义为不超过$x$的素数的个数，即$$\pi(x):=\#\{p\in \mathbb{P}:p\leq x\}$$那么关于此函数我们有渐近展开$$\pi(x)=\frac{x}{\log(x)}+O\left(\frac{x}{\log^2(x)}\right)$$

classification_result.id: n个连续的阶乘之积有多少个因子#4
classification_result.english_title: Prime Number Theorem, de la Vallee Poussin and Hadamard 1896
